description: What the main window's webview may ask of the app: its own fourteen commands (listed in build.rs) and nothing else: `boot`, `engine_command`, `daemon_resolve_current`, `storage_set`, `dialog_confirm`, `dialog_alert`, `open_external`, `save_begin`, `save_write`, `save_finish`, `save_discard`, `transfers_set`, `preview_mount` and `preview_release`. Of the core permissions only listening for events is granted (`core:event:allow-listen` and `allow-unlisten`; Tauri cannot scope them to names, and the app emits only `daemons_changed` and `daemons_manage`): the page calls no window API and emits nothing, and dialogs, file dialogs and links are opened from Rust. The origin that serves previewed documents is granted nothing: no capability names it and there is no remote-origin grant.
